nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Brightening Toner

avis.titre: Limited effect as a brighting toner
avis.texte: I have used this toner for a bit more than half a year, 3 bottles worth, with no results in terms of brightness. The cica works well, but the brightening effect was not noticeable at all with paired with a cleanser. It also left a sticky residue on my face afterwards which was a bit unpleasant. I have since switched to a full K Beauty routine from which I did achieve brightening effects rather than toner+cleanser+moisturizer. So perhaps I wasn't doing a proper routine, and this was merely a component of a brightening routine. However my routine's toner is now vitamin C based, and does not leave behind a sticky residue; and based on that, this toner did not work for me; and I've given it a shot, well... 3 bottles of it.

avis.titre: Stings a little but very cooling, calming and hydrating!
avis.texte: My skin: dry, sensitive and eczema prone. I use this product along with Hyalu-CICA Blue Serum. Whenever I use these two I know when my skin barrier is weak because it stings and leaves a little redness. However, when my skin barrier is stronger these products leave it feeling refreshed and plump. It is cooling and very hydrating. I notice my skin glow! I do not recommend if your skin barrier is destroyed. It may burn. While cica and ceramides are amazing and help repair skin barrier the combination of other ingredients in this line may backfire and cause harm. ALWAYS do patch testing.

Just started using this about 3 weeks ago. This toner is light, not overly scented and doesn’t feel sticky at all. A tiny bit goes a long way as it’s worked into the skit. The bottle is super large so you get a lot for your money and it will go a long way. I’m starting to see the surface of my skin look so much smoother and it feels more supple too.

I’ve been using this toner now for 1.5 months and it’s helped keep my face fresh and clean! My pores have notably decreased in size. This toner is scent free and feels so refreshing on the skin. I don’t have any redness or burning either so it must be pretty gentle since I have sensitive skin. I would definitely purchase again!

I’ve been using the brightening toner and was sold out. So I desperately ordered this so I can replace my old toner for the meantime. I think they have the same effects expect for some reason it kinda make my face a little bit dry. But I still love how it helps with my blemishes.
I love a good toner!! I have combo skin and this toner really helps balance my skin. Its Moisturizing and gentle. 10 out of 10 absolutely reccomend!!!
exactly as pictured. I’m totally obsessed with the bottle but also it helps my skin feel hydrated and it smells nice. I would recommend

Qué robo!! Pensé que sería la versión de 210 ML como se anuncia en las fotos pero resulta que es la se 50 ML (lean bien la descripción). Me di una gran sorpresa cuando el artículo llegó, pues por el precio debería ser la versión grande. Pésimo servicio.
best toner and hydrates the skin immediately and given a natural dewy look. No fragrance and safe on sensitive skin.
Made my skin glow day and night. No make up needed just love living in my skin and this product just added the glow I’ve been looking for.

This brightening toner is part of a K-Beauty skincare line that contains the soothing ingredient Madagascar Centella for sensitive skin, and I pair it with their super hydrating serum in the same line. [See photo of both products together] Unlike the serum, the toner has a complete ingredient list on the box in English. It's one of the richest feeling toners I've used and stands out as an astringent with AHA, Hyaluronic Acid and the Madagascar Centella formula that hydrates, refines pores, and brightens skin. It's not the typical watery toner even though it looks like it in the bottle. Instead, it has more texture and smells faintly fresh, but disappears on application. The thing I notice the most is the soothing sensation and smoothness to the skin without any stickiness. It's supposed to be for dry skin, but honestly it doesn't feel that hydrating once it absorbs. So, it's not my fave toner (or the serum either), but they're both reasonably priced and supposedly focused on hydration and brightening. An AHA that also hydrates sounds conflicting. I probably wouldn't re-order either one, unless I discover a moisturizer in the brand's line-up. I passed on ordering the mask because it contains lavender, which irritates my skin. Okay, but not a go-to toner or serum for me.

I have had good skin for as long as I could remember. Rarely any bumps or acne. But after using this it completely damaged my skin. My face is now full of bumps that will not go away. Thanks to this I have to figure out how to get my skin back to normal. I put in a picture of before and after using this product. HORRIFIC!
